name: list_deployments
description: List Serverless API deployments in the caller's account.

name: get_deployment
description: Get one deployment by ID.

name: create_deployment
description: Create a Serverless API (ComfyUI) deployment.

name: update_deployment
description: Partially update a deployment.

name: delete_deployment
description: Permanently delete a deployment.

name: submit_request
description: Submit an async inference request to a deployment.

name: get_request_status
description: Poll a request's current status.

name: get_request_result
description: Fetch a completed request's outputs.

name: cancel_request
description: Cancel a queued or running request.

name: call_instance_proxy
description: Call a ComfyUI backend endpoint on a live instance.

name: list_models
description: Browse the hosted models that ``run_model`` can run.

name: list_model_categories
description: List the capability categories models are grouped into.

name: get_model
description: Get one hosted model's input schema.

name: run_model
description: Run a hosted RunComfy model on demand — no deployment needed.

name: get_model_request_status
description: Poll a Model API request's current status.

name: get_model_request_result
description: Fetch a completed Model API request's outputs.

name: cancel_model_request
description: Cancel a queued Model API request.

name: create_dataset
description: Create an empty training dataset.

name: list_datasets
description: List training datasets in the caller's account.

name: get_dataset_status
description: Get a dataset's status and its successfully uploaded files.

name: delete_dataset
description: Permanently delete a training dataset.

name: upload_dataset_file_from_url
description: Add one file to a dataset by fetching it from a public URL.

name: upload_dataset_text_file
description: Add a text file — normally a caption — to a dataset.

name: get_dataset_upload_urls
description: Get signed upload URLs for dataset files the server cannot fetch.

name: submit_training_job
description: Submit an AI Toolkit training job (typically LoRA training).

name: get_training_job_status
description: Poll a training job's status and step progress.

name: get_training_job_result
description: Fetch a training job's artifacts as hosted URLs.

name: cancel_training_job
description: Cancel a queued or running training job.

name: resume_training_job
description: Resume a stopped training job from its latest checkpoint.

name: edit_training_job
description: Replace the config of a non-running training job.

name: get_balance
description: Get the account's remaining RunComfy balance.
